verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents first-party ways to move data out of its managed cloud: one-click migration from Appwrite Cloud to a self-hosted instance, a dedicated native PostgreSQL database reachable directly with psql, and file download APIs. However, no documented bulk export of all project data (users, rows, files) in open formats like CSV or JSON was found. missing for 10: documented full-account export in open formats, coverage of auth/user data export, independent hands-on corroboration of leaving the platform.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: You can also migrate between Appwrite Cloud and self-hosted.
A dedicated, native PostgreSQL database you connect to directly.
Connect with psql, Prisma, or Drizzle, install pgvector, and get backups, replicas, pooling, and PITR.
It provides APIs to upload, download, delete, and list files, with many added utilities.
